description: Dept. of Forest Conversation- Forest Conversation Ordinance Order Under Section 3 Karangawa Forest Reserve
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of a Reserved Forest under the Forest Conservation Ordinance and places it under the control of the Conservator General of Forests. This constitutes a regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a land gazette, as it focuses on the legal designation and control of the land rather than property ownership, transfers, or land titles.
